key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: Identifiers of the agent providers rendered in the panel menu.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the extension asks the collector for fresh usage data.

key.name: show-percentage
key.summary: Show the highest usage percentage in the panel

key.name: show-countdown
key.summary: Show a countdown to each limit reset

key.name: show-scoped-limits
key.description: Include per-model allowances alongside the account-wide windows.

key.name: ai-agent-usage-toggle
key.summary: Shortcut to open the usage popup
key.description: Opens or closes the AI Agents popup from anywhere. Empty disables it.

key.name: warning-threshold
key.description: Usage at or above this percentage is highlighted.
